review_kind: Eight complete source-vetted C#/Java/Jest testing and documentation packages; NOT governed review or behavioral validation
macro_findings: Five test-framework checklists are reusable reference material but omit pinned framework versions, runner compatibility and authorization before dependency changes or side-effecting test execution.
The broad .NET best-practices procedure hardcodes MSTest, Semantic Kernel, namespace and architectural patterns regardless of project context; reject unchanged, extract narrow checks only.
The .NET timezone package includes two bundled references; stale Brazil/Egypt DST assertions, location-document privacy scope and recurring-job authority are hard failures for unchanged use.
All eight are new path-matched candidate decisions, not governed exact-version admissions; source-neutral capability directory retains scores and evidence links separately from approved use.
Seven packages have one SKILL.md each; timezone contains SKILL.md plus two references. Exact tree reconstruction verifies complete pinned package identity.
